# Test Fixtures

This directory contains deterministic fixtures for the trading notice modules.

- `coinglass_heatmap_valid.html`: SVG heatmap with axis ticks and upper/lower bars.
- `coinglass_heatmap_missing_svg.html`: page fixture with required chart content missing.
- `coinglass_heatmap_bad_axis.html`: SVG fixture with invalid axis anchors.
- `blank_heatmap.png`: intentionally blank screenshot fixture.

Fixtures must use fake values only and must not include real credentials,
cookies, API keys, SMTP passwords, or authenticated browser state.
